businesses."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Primarily leases fiber and copper network capacity to carriers under long-term contracts, a wholesale infrastructure model rather than retail service."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Satellite broadband and defense communications using satellite fleets and terminals, a different technology and customer base."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Makes network test equipment, optical components and security materials, a manufacturing business rather than a service provider."}]}
